chapter three · tap the envelope

Dear Rahab,

Happy birthday to one of the bubbliest, sweetest people I know. ♡

I hope this new chapter gives you every reason to smile. I hope you get the kind of happiness that feels peaceful, genuine and completely yours.

Never forget how loved you are. Keep your heart soft, your laughter loud, and your spark alive. You deserve beautiful things, beautiful people and beautiful days.

Here's to growing, glowing and becoming everything you're meant to be.

Happy birthday, my girly ♡
